sample_policy: one cold sample per model/strategy; repeat for publication-grade confidence

classifications.current_loading_behavior: lazy demand-fault residency; cold 32B first eval is about 37 s
classifications.full_preload: explicit pread removes compute-time page faults but has about 25 s host-residency startup on 32B
classifications.overlap: measured; S3 H4 and S4 H2 reduce 32B end-to-end time to about 35 s
classifications.physical_bottleneck: storage bandwidth; measured loader is about 1.4 GB/s while compute consumes layer spans faster
classifications.final_recommendation: no production change from this qualification; bounded overlap is the leading policy candidate, pending repeated runs
